name: Nozomien
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional elder care facility (Nozomi-en): a flower-viewing event notice, a first day volunteering at the facility, a visiting-hours guide, a Respect-for-the-Aged Day event notice, a facility tour guide, a reflection on learning from a resident, a report on teaching a new staff member how to run recreation activities, an essay on why individualized rehabilitation grew popular, a typhoon/heavy-rain visiting contingency guide, a column on care becoming more individualized, a notice of revised day-service contract terms, a reflection on a cherry tree that stays in the garden, and a one-year cooperation report on a partnership with a local volunteer group. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
